answer: Random beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat freeze out hollow identities. Each agent locks 30 POA and proves live work each epoch. The beacon samples 5% per epoch; each must answer a compute challenge in an hour. Miss it and the bond is slashed, the identity frozen in a glacier. 100 fakes cost 100 x 30 POA plus live compute, far above the ~900 POA pool. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted; the tundra freezes only the hollow.
